specification.objective: Deliver company-opt-in semantic recommendations of existing project tasks in the work-log dialog, with secure tenant-scoped OpenAI-compatible embedding-provider configuration, auditable administration, privacy disclosure, and unchanged manual confirmation/time-clock behavior.

requirements.statement: Company AI configuration is isolated per company, absent/default disabled, and readable/writable only with companies.manage in the current company context.
Provider URL/model and API key can be saved, rotated, removed, tested, and masked; the API key is encrypted at rest and never returned, logged, or written to audit metadata.

Only an explicit administrator privacy acknowledgement plus complete validated configuration enables recommendations; disabling/removal immediately prevents new calls; configuration changes are audited without credentials or activity text.

The backend calls only an HTTPS OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint, validates public DNS destinations and pins the connection to validated addresses, rejects redirects, applies bounded timeouts/body/concurrency limits, and never permits private/loopback/link-local/reserved destinations.

Before ranking, enforce current-company project access and feature enablement; send only the work description and minimal name/description text for tasks in that selected authorized project; return up to three stable cosine-ranked recommendations without persisting or logging prompts/responses.

Ranking errors, no matches, disabled state, empty descriptions, and No project never block manual task selection or work-log submission; suggestions never auto-select and only explicitly checked IDs enter the existing WorkLogPayload.
Project/description changes and out-of-order responses cannot display stale recommendations; local keyboard/screen-reader/mobile UI is pt-BR and never exposes the provider key.

Provide a sanitized curated Portuguese evaluation set, a deterministic lexical baseline, and a reproducible top-1/top-3/false-suggestion evaluation; document embedding-provider compatibility, data-sharing, limitations, billing, disablement and rollback.

acceptance_criteria.statement: API tests cover denied roles, per-tenant isolation and disabled-by-default state; admin changes require companies.manage and explicit privacy acknowledgement to enable.
Tests verify encrypted key storage, masked GET responses, replacement/removal, audit redaction, and no secret in error/log/audit payloads.

SSRF tests reject non-HTTPS URLs, userinfo, loopback/private/link-local/reserved DNS (including mixed public/private answers), redirects, and oversized/invalid responses; provider requests are bounded and pinned.
Authorized recommendations are derived only from tasks within the current accessible project; tenant/project access violations and disabled companies cause zero provider calls.
Embedding vectors produce deterministic, stable top-three cosine ranking with no fabricated confidence; provider/network/model failures safely return no suggestions.
Widget and flow tests prove suggestions are advisory and unchecked, only manual checkbox selections are submitted, No project remains unchanged, and project/query races suppress stale data.

An evaluation fixture contains representative Portuguese exact/paraphrase/overlap/irrelevant/no-match cases and a reproducible baseline-vs-embedding metric command; provider compatibility and privacy/disablement are documented.

invariants.statement: No secret, raw work-log description, provider response, or unrelated/cross-project task is disclosed outside the minimum request to an explicitly enabled provider.
Suggestions are never persisted or linked automatically; task_ids in the existing work-log API remain solely employee-confirmed selections.
Existing manual task selection, no-project behavior, work-log schema and punch state transitions remain compatible.

forbidden_states.statement: AI enabled by default, across tenants, or from the browser; direct browser provider calls or exposure of any stored API key.
SSRF to non-public networks, redirect following, unbounded requests/responses, or transmitting another tenant/project's tasks.
Automatic task selection/association, logs/audit records containing prompts or credentials, or blocking manual operation when AI fails.

inputs.statement: GitHub issue #153 full requirements and acceptance criteria at https://github.com/MarcosAlves90/touchin/issues/153.
origin/main at acf03172cee14b760f812e6eb84bcd34ffd39e03; existing companies.manage authorization, encrypted FieldCipher, audit trail, project/task access rules and WorkLogDialog contract.

outputs.statement: Secure server-side company configuration and OpenAI-compatible embeddings recommendation endpoints with isolated tests.
Accessible optional task suggestions integrated into the existing manual work-log selection flow, plus admin setup UI.
Privacy and provider documentation, representative evaluation data, and full regression evidence.

failure_semantics.statement: The target backend regression suite fails before implementation because the recommendation service/API does not yet exist, then passes after implementation; no baseline test is weakened.
Provider errors, invalid embeddings, access denial, or network safety uncertainty produce no recommendations and never degrade manual submission or fail open to an unvalidated URL.

Any failure of repo quality gates or any external key/task data leakage blocks delivery; remote-provider semantic quality is reported only as measured using the available test doubles/evaluation evidence.
